signatures.description: Implement Chernyaev's Marching Cubes 33 table-driven isosurface extractor with correct resolution of the six ambiguous face configurations plus the interior (body) ambiguity, so every case yields a topologically consistent, manifold, self-intersection-free triangulation. Given a scalar field sampled on an n^3 lattice, an isovalue, and a fixed face/asymptotic decider rule, output deterministic vertex and triangle lists under a specified tie-break order, then verify manifoldness: each edge has one or two incident triangles, Euler characteristic matches the field's topology, and no degenerate triangle is emitted.
